description: Install browser-use and update project dependencies. Verify the package installs cleanly and basic imports work.
steps: Update pyproject.toml: replace 'playwright' and 'groq' dependencies with 'browser-use>=0.12.8'. Keep pyyaml, pydantic[email]>=2.0, python-dotenv, click. The browser-use package already includes groq as a dependency.
Remove the playwright dependency entirely since browser-use uses its own browser management (cdp-use/playwright internally).
Run pip install -e '.[dev]' in the .venv to install the new dependencies.
Verify imports work: python -c 'from browser_use import Agent, BrowserSession, BrowserProfile, ChatGroq'
Run 'python -c "from naukri_apply.models import UserProfile, ApplicationResult"' to confirm existing models still import correctly.
acceptance_criteria: python -c 'from browser_use import Agent, BrowserSession, BrowserProfile, ChatGroq' exits 0
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/computer_use && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' and confirm exit 0
Run: .venv/bin/python -c 'from browser_use import Agent, BrowserSession, BrowserProfile, ChatGroq; print("OK")' and confirm OK output
findings: browser-use 0.12.8 was not available on PyPI; used 0.12.7 (latest available). ChatGroq is importable from browser_use directly. groq package was upgraded from 1.2.0 to 1.0.0 (browser-use pins it). click was downgraded from 8.4.1 to 8.3.1 by browser-use. pydantic downgraded from 2.13.4 to 2.12.5 due to browser-use constraints. All naukri_apply model and config tests pass.
